# Modular source

This folder contains the editable HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The repository's
[root HTML](../index.html) is the generated, self-contained app used by GitHub
Pages. After changing these source files, follow the
[build instructions](../tools/README.md) to update that root file and the
standalone ZIP. See the [developer guide](../DEVELOPER.md) for the recurrence,
signed LLS conventions, and module responsibilities.
